content.text: MongoDB text indexes let you search string fields for words or phrases using the $text operator.
For advanced search (fuzzy, autocomplete, filters), use MongoDB Atlas Search powered by Lucene.

questions.question: What must you create before using $text queries?
questions.explanation: $text requires a text index on the fields you want to search.

faq.q: Can I have multiple text indexes per collection?
faq.a: No. A collection can have only one text index, but it can cover multiple fields.
